name: uber
strip_regex: ]*>(?:(?!
notes: Removed from an Uber ride receipt: the app download and Download PDF buttons; the static map image, whose query string carries the pickup and dropoff coordinates; the social link row; the corporate address footer and the account and terms link cluster; and the support, lost item and help modules. The last pattern covers the older standalone rate your trip row; no row of that shape is present in this sample, and it is kept because the shorter Lime and cancelled ride templates still carry one. Two patterns here are written and then skipped, because each block prints a figure shaped like an amount and the guard will not take an amount out of a receipt. The Uber One cashback strip prints the $1.18 it credited, which is a real figure on a real receipt and is arguably part of it. The rate and tip module prints the driver's 4.92 rating, which is not money at all but cannot be told from money by its shape, so the module stays, minus its live controls, which are defused like every other link. Kept verbatim: the total, every fare line item including surcharges and promotions, the trip date and clock times, the pickup and dropoff rows, the product tier, and the payment rows with the card last four and the charge posting time.
